basic_info.description: This light-filled top-floor condominium boasts an open, airy feel with breathtaking panoramic views of San Francisco. The updated kitchen, with its peninsula bar, flows seamlessly into the open dining and living areas, creating an ideal space for entertaining. Step outside to your private balcony for a morning coffee with views over Noe and Eureka Valleys, or unwind by the wood-burning fireplace for a quiet evening in. The home features spacious bedrooms and a primary en-suite with abundant closet space and skylights that maximize natural light throughout. With the Romain pedestrian bridge just next door, you will be just a short walk to the popular amenities in Noe Valley and beyond! One-car independent parking and extra storage included.
